title: 🛒 Multiple Customer Service & Retail Jobs in Gallatin County, MT - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Gallatin County’s retail and service scene is buzzing this season, with several local employers hiring for full- and part-time roles. Whether you’re after steady hours, flexible shifts, or a people-first workplace, there’s something here for you.
Fresh Cut Produce Clerk – Albertsons Companies Location: Belgrade, MT | Type: Full-Time
Work hands-on with fresh fruits and veggies while keeping displays looking great. Albertsons offers weekly pay, flexible schedules, and employee discounts.
Cashier – Parkland Corporation (Store 80205) Location: Bozeman, MT | Type: Full-Time
Join a friendly team serving customers at the fuel and convenience store. Benefits include next-day pay, 401(k) match, and tuition reimbursement.
Auto Care Center Team Associate – Walmart Location: Bozeman, MT | Type: Full-Time | Pay: $20–$33/hr
Help customers keep their cars in top shape while enjoying Walmart’s strong benefits, paid education, and performance bonuses.
Auto Care Center Service Writer – Walmart Location: Bozeman, MT | Type: Full-Time | Pay: $20–$33/hr
Support the Auto Care team by coordinating service orders and customer communication. Includes health coverage, PTO, and 401(k).
Entertainment Team Associate – Walmart Location: Bozeman, MT | Type: Full-Time | Pay: $20–$33/hr
If you love tech and helping people find the right gadgets, this role offers steady hours and full benefits.
Retail Print Sales Supervisor – Staples Location: Three Forks, MT | Type: Full-Time
Lead a small team in the print center, helping customers with creative projects. Includes bonus eligibility, paid time off, and medical coverage.
Dairy / Frozen Clerk – Town & Country Foods Location: Belgrade, MT | Type: Part-Time | Pay: $20/hr
Join a 100% employee-owned grocery store with flexible scheduling and on-the-job training.
Overnight Stock Clerk – Town & Country Foods Location: Belgrade, MT | Type: Full-Time | Pay: $22/hr
Perfect for night owls—keep shelves stocked and organized while earning solid pay and benefits.
Meat Clerk – Town & Country Foods Location: Belgrade, MT | Type: Full-Time | Pay: $21–$23/hr
Work in a supportive, employee-owned environment preparing and stocking fresh meat products.
Fuel Station Attendant – Safeway Location: Bozeman, MT | Type: Part-Time
Be the friendly face at the pump while keeping the station clean and safe. Includes flexible hours and store discounts.
Campground Registration Clerk – Bozeman Hot Springs Campground & RV Park Location: Bozeman, MT | Type: Full-Time (Seasonal) | Pay: $19–$20/hr
Greet campers, manage reservations, and help guests enjoy their stay at this popular local destination.
